verses.text: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
lines: “Do you think this to be your right,
or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

verses.text: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
lines: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you?
What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

verses.text: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
lines: I will answer you,
and your companions with you.

verses.text: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
lines: Look to the skies, and see.
See the skies, which are higher than you.

verses.text: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
lines: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him?
If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

verses.text: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
lines: If you are righteous, what do you give him?
Or what does he receive from your hand?

verses.text: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
lines: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are,
and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

verses.text: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
lines: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out.
They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

verses.text: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
lines: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker,
who gives songs in the night,

verses.text: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
lines: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth,
and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

verses.text: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.
lines: There they cry, but no one answers,
because of the pride of evil men.

verses.text: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.
lines: Surely God will not hear an empty cry,
neither will the Almighty regard it.

verses.text: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
lines: How much less when you say you don’t see him.
The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

verses.text: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance.
lines: But now, because he has not visited in his anger,
neither does he greatly regard arrogance.

verses.text: Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
lines: Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk,
and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
